title: Permutation Feature Importance by Hand
learning_objectives: Measure importance as the score drop after permuting a feature
Repeat permutations with a seeded generator and report mean/std
entry_point: permutation_importance(predict, X, y, score, n_repeats=5, seed=0)
hints: For each j, r: `Xp = X.copy(); Xp[:, j] = X[rng.permutation(n), j]`.
Collect drops `base - score(y, predict(Xp))`; take mean and std per feature.

failure_feedback.advice: One default_rng(seed); loop features outer, repeats inner; permute rows of column j only.
Importance = baseline score − permuted score (don't refit).
Permute a copy of X, not X itself.
Return mean and std arrays with one entry per feature.
